messages:
rachel: Heads-up — planning to push release v2.23 to prod tonight at 22:00 PST. Can folks confirm smoke owners and rollback readiness?

alex: I can own the canary smoke and monitoring during the 22:00 window. Will be @ing SLO/alerts.

priya: I can be on-call for post-deploy regressions. Keeping my pager on.

liam: Infra checklist done. Capacity reserved on dedicated cluster pool. Autoscaler policy set to conservative for first 30m.

marta: I'll validate tracing and error budgets during the canary. Also prepared quick rollback steps if latency spikes.

rachel: Great. Quick checklist (please reply with :white_check_mark: when ok):
- [ ] Canary owner assigned (alex)
- [ ] On-call assigned (priya)
- [ ] Infra capacity check (liam)
- [ ] Observability smoke (marta)
- [ ] Rollback plan documented

alex: :white_check_mark: Canary owner assigned. Canary will be 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation holds.

priya: :white_check_mark: On-call assigned. My escalation path: rachel -> eng-sre.

liam: :white_check_mark: Capacity check done. Nodepool has spare for +40% burst. If OOMs, we have fallback to older model variant.

marta: :white_check_mark: Observability ready. Dashboards pinned, alert thresholds set. Will run smoke commands around +2m after canary.

rachel: Rollback plan (copying here):
```bash
# rollback to previous deployment
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/inference-runtime --to-revision=42
# revert routing at gateway
redwoodctl route set --service inference --tag v2.22
```
If anyone wants to add more commands, paste them here.

alex: One more note — disable batching optimization flag during canary: `BATCH_OPT=false` to reduce variance. Will re-enable after 1h if stable.

liam: infra-bot: scheduling drain window at 21:50->22:10 for node maintenance?

infra-bot: scheduled maintenance window conflicts with deploy window. Recommending we move deploy +10m or skip maintenance.

rachel: Let's skip maintenance tonight, keep deploy at 22:00. liam, can you cancel the drain?

liam: Done. Canceled drain, confirmed nodepool unchanged.

deploy-bot: Deploy for v2.23 scheduled by rachel at 2025-11-14 22:00 PST. Canary steps configured.

priya: Quick smoke commands I'll run after canary passes:
- curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/ping | jq .status
- run `smoke_scripts/chat_smoke.sh --iterations 50 --seed 42`

marta: Also running synthetic latency test: `latency-check --target inference --duration 5m`

rachel: All signoffs received, proceeding with scheduled deploy. If anything changes ping here. :rocket: 

alex: I'll post updates during rollout. If I see >10% error or +150ms p95 increase we abort and rollback.

priya: Acknowledged. Pager on.

marta: Capturing logs and traces.

rachel: Thanks team — end of thread for coordination.
